decision: Approved frozen v6 opt-in policy and exact inherited Stage39 implementation. Ordinary managed rendering does not emit scroll-surface hints by default. No remaining material source finding in the reviewed delta.
limits: No Go/native/GUI/provider/prepare/Git execution by reviewer. Only read-only stdlib hash/reconstruction scripts ran.
Property is immutable in framework lifecycle, not an enforceable restriction on arbitrary direct Core callers. Such callers must obey native ownership and synchronization contracts.
Modal/additional-scene default behavior is source-backed through local property lookup and fresh Scene construction, not separately executed in a new runtime test by reviewer.

Earlier v5 correctness/source approval and its reported ordinary latency regression remain separate historical evidence. This certificate performs no independent metric recomputation and establishes no performance improvement.

The curve kernel remains globally active and has intentional antialias changes described in prior certificates/spec; disabling hints selects ordinary complete replay, not preceding-kernel pixel parity.
Experimental reuse is explicitly optional and not a recommended latency setting. Full GPU image copy/upload, physical presentation/native memory and 4/6ms/full-Mac acceptance remain unqualified.

policy_review.conclusion: Public bool zero value is false. Driver.Run has a value receiver, so the configuration is copied at invocation. Every owned new main body receives the captured setting before metrics mounting, reconciliation and its native Run.

Public ManualConfig bool defaults false and flows through by-value validation into private implementation.config. Owned topology construction initializes each main body before managed mount/RunManual; caller changes to its config variable cannot alter this copied bool.

Property lookup occurs before collecting paint items or constructing a hint. Missing/false/wrong-type values call the original Frame.RenderWidget and return. Enabled main panes retain VerifyPaint and the prior ordered paint proof.

Core Property returns only the local Properties map; it does not inherit a parent/main-scene value. Core NewScene constructs a fresh node. Separate modal/popup scenes therefore lack this internal property unless explicitly configured elsewhere. Framework setter call sites are only the two owned startup paths; there is no refresh-time toggle.

qualification_state: Source approval is final for these bytes. Final v6 driver/API/build gate was still running at certificate creation and is deliberately not claimed PASS here; producer final receipt must be bound separately.

scope.inherited_renderer: Same12 prepared outputs and same patch as approved v5; no renderer algorithm/kernel changes in v6.
